fusions.name: Pilfered Moment
fusions.desc: Snatches at an enemy up to 6 tiles away with a hand of arcana, dealing 11 damage, rising to 1.3 times at full range, and leaving it [Stalled] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Juggled Sparks
fusions.desc: Tosses a cone of juggled sparks 4 tiles ahead that deals 7 damage to everything caught, with a 30% chance of [Leaden] for 4 seconds. Holds up to 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Slipped Knots
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 control conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Sleight of Step
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow that would have hit you is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
